description.p: chatot is a native WhatsApp client for GNOME. It links to your phone as a companion device, like WhatsApp Web, and keeps your chats, groups, communities, channels and status updates in a GTK4 and libadwaita window that follows the system's light and dark styles.

ul.li: Text, replies, reactions, forwards, edits and deletes
Photos, videos, voice notes, documents, stickers and GIFs, with an in-app viewer
Locations with an inline map, live locations and place search
Groups, communities, channels and status updates
Full-text message search, archive, pins, mutes and starred messages
Several linked accounts in one window
Desktop notifications and a tray item with the unread count

description.p: chatot is an unofficial client built on the whatsmeow library. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or supported by WhatsApp or Meta. Using an unofficial client may be against WhatsApp's terms of service.

screenshot.caption: A group conversation with replies and mentions
Photos, clips, voice notes and documents in a chat

description.p: First public beta: chats, groups, communities, channels, status updates, media, voice notes, locations, search and multi-account support.
